title: ISS Symposium 2012: Day 1 Highlights
description: The ISS Symposium 2012 has kicked off in Berlin. On the first day representatives from the main space agencies discussed the future path and priorities for research on the Space Station. The three-day Symposium is covering case-studies in fundamental and applied research and the actual or potential spin-offs for the benefit of humankind.
author: European Space Agency, ESA
